basic_details.job_title: Tiruppur District Sanitation Worker Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

The number of posts is not printed. Completed forms must be submitted at the District Collector's Office, Third Floor, Room No. 304, by 5.00 PM on 4 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Tiruppur District Collector Office Sanitation Workers at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the pay amount, the application fee or the selection process in detail.

rows.details: Office of the District Collector, Tiruppur
Must have completed 18 years, live in the panchayat or a neighbouring panchayat, and be interested in sanitation work
Village panchayats of Tiruppur district, including 13 named panchayats in Tiruppur and Palladam panchayat unions
Submit the completed form at the Collector's Office, Third Floor, Room No. 304

content_sections.heading: About the Recruitment
content_sections.text: The notice says it is meant to maintain sanitation in the village panchayats of Tiruppur district and to put the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 and the Supreme Court guidelines into effect. Waste is to be collected from all houses in segregated form: degradable, non-degradable, sanitary and special waste. This is so that degradable waste can be turned into compost. The notice says that additional sanitation workers are needed in 13 village panchayats near Tiruppur Corporation, in the Tiruppur and Palladam panchayat unions. Workers are also needed in all other village panchayats for house-to-house collection.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Submit the completed application at the District Collector's Office, Third Floor, Room No. 304, Tiruppur, by 5.00 PM on 4 December 2026. The notice does not name a postal mode or an email address. It prints the application form on its second page, headed "Application for the post of Sanitation Workers appointment". The form asks for: Applicant's name and father's or husband's name Gender (male, female or transgender) Date of birth and age Present and permanent address Educational qualification Aadhaar number and family card number Caste (OC, BC, MBC, SC or ST) and mobile number The panchayat union and village panchayat for which the applicant is applying Whether the applicant belongs to a self-help group and, if so, the group's name, the year it started and the date the last bank linkage was received The form has a box for a photograph and a space for the applicant's signature.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Age: the applicant must have completed 18 years. The notice prints no upper limit and no cut-off date for age. Residence: the applicant must live in the panchayat that needs the worker or in a neighbouring panchayat. The applicant must be interested in doing sanitation work. Preference will be given to holders of a driving licence. The notice says that private persons and youth may also take part in the work. The notice does not print an educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details. The 13 panchayats named for additional workers are: Mangalam Eduvai Kalipalayam Kanakkampalayam Mudalipalayam Pongupalayam Arumuthampalayam Ganapathipalayam Karaipudur Manickapuram Panikkampatti Sempipalayam Vadugapalayampudur

content_sections.heading: Tiruppur District Collector Office Sanitation Workers Job Description
content_sections.text: Collect segregated garbage from 150 houses a day and hand it over at the specified place. Start work between 6.00 AM and 7.00 AM and finish between 11.00 AM and 12.00 noon.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copy of Aadhaar card Copy of family card Copy of bank passbook Applicant's signature on the form Photograph in the box on the form

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says that the selection for this work and the honorarium will be carried out through the district agency working under the National Rural Livelihood Mission and through the Panchayat Level Federation (PLF) of each village panchayat. It does not describe any test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Tiruppur Sanitation Worker posts?
faq.answer: The completed application must be submitted by 5.00 PM on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Where should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: It should be submitted at the District Collector's Office, Third Floor, Room No. 304, Tiruppur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The applicant must have completed 18 years. The notice prints no upper age limit.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply?
faq.answer: The applicant must live in the panchayat that needs the worker or in a neighbouring panchayat, and must be interested in sanitation work. Private persons and youth may also take part.

faq.question: Q5. Which panchayats need additional sanitation workers?
faq.answer: The notice names 13: Mangalam, Eduvai, Kalipalayam, Kanakkampalayam, Mudalipalayam, Pongupalayam, Arumuthampalayam, Ganapathipalayam, Karaipudur, Manickapuram, Panikkampatti, Sempipalayam and Vadugapalayampudur. Workers are also needed in all other village panchayats.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents must be enclosed?
faq.answer: Copies of the Aadhaar card, the family card and the bank passbook must be enclosed. The applicant must also sign the form.

faq.question: Q7. What is the daily work and timing?
faq.answer: A worker collects segregated garbage from 150 houses a day and hands it over at a specified place. Work starts between 6.00 AM and 7.00 AM and is to finish between 11.00 AM and 12.00 noon.

faq.question: Q8. Does a driving licence help?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says preference will be given to holders of a driving licence.

faq.question: Q9. Who will select the workers and decide the honorarium?
faq.answer: The notice says selection and the honorarium will be carried out through the district agency under the National Rural Livelihood Mission and the Panchayat Level Federation (PLF) of each village panchayat.
